author: VeroLM
description:
VeroMotion
	

Video clips where things actually move.
VeroMotion is a collection of short, single-shot video clips that were selected for sustained object motion, built for next-frame prediction, video modelling and world-model research. Most large video corpora are dominated by near-static footage (talking heads, slideshows, locked-off shots). VeroMotion keeps the opposite: clips in which objects keep moving for most of the clip, with camera motion filtered out of the score.
